head_commit: (control-plane feature commit on feat/copier-live-demo-control-plane; see PR)
summary: Repository-only, DARK control-plane completion for the governed #46->#48 live copy-trading demo. Resolves the run_copier_execute shadow-vs-live contradiction (docstring was factually wrong; the LIVE OPEN path IS reachable), adds the supported single-authorization revoke + expired-ACTIVE reconciliation commands, a read-only machine-readable demo-preflight command, the four missing DARK producer/dispatcher worker commands that complete one authoritative worker sequence, the authoritative worker-sequence doc, and the deterministic human runbook. No production deploy, no host contact, no flag enablement, no authorization creation, no order. No migration.
phase1_preflight: Read-only dry-run of provision_authorized_live_copier_bridge (packet 039) established the 5 arm gates; this PR is repository-only and mutates no production state.

delivery_state: PR_READY — repository-only, DARK/default-OFF, auto-merge OFF, STOP before merge. No production deployment, no Windows-host contact, no flag enablement, no authorization creation, no order/modify/close. All new worker commands are no-ops with flags OFF.
worker_sequence_authoritative: OPEN: run_copier_observer -> run_copier_replication -> run_copier_execute (produce_one -> admit_open -> LIVE: admit_open_live -> create_live_open_job PLACE_ORDER under select_for_update lock, 1 allowance/lock). MODIFY/CLOSE: run_copier_lifecycle -> run_copier_execute_modifies/closes (create_live_modify_job/create_live_full_close_job) -> run_copier_mutation_dispatch (run_mutation_dispatch_pass -> per-tenant transport -> #48 bridge). See docs/COPIER_LIVE_WORKER_SEQUENCE.md.
contradiction_resolution: run_copier_execute is NOT shadow-only. execution_producer.produce_one routes a LIVE follower to create_live_open_job (a real live PLACE_ORDER) when fully authorized/armed; the prior 'DEMO-only / Never LIVE' docstring predated the ADR-0057 live OPEN producer and is corrected in this PR.
no_late_recovery_proof: OPEN consumes the authorization allowance under the same select_for_update lock (no second order on retry); the mutation transport is one-shot (UNKNOWN_OUTCOME on timeout/non-2xx, never retried, never success); no late-OPEN path exists; admission is read-fresh/time-bound and fails closed on restart/expiry/identity drift. All paths inert with flags OFF.
migration_status: NONE. makemigrations --check (trade_copier): No changes detected. No new authorization status added; reconciliation uses the existing REVOKED terminal state.
limitations: The LIVE MODIFY/CLOSE worker path (producers + mutation dispatcher) had no production command before this PR; it is now added DARK but has not been exercised end-to-end against a live follower in production.
copier_live_demo_preflight reports host-side gates (bridge/watchdog/host-admission/follower positions) as HOST_PROBE_REQUIRED (fail-closed) — the backend cannot read them without the agent token.
Whole-project makemigrations --check reports unrelated pre-existing index renames in the strategies app (not introduced here).
Deployment, host arming, flag enablement, authorization creation and the Sponsor-present demo remain SEPARATE, separately-authorized steps.
production_host_broker_impact: NONE. No deploy, no Windows-host contact, no flag enablement, no authorization creation, no broker order/modification/close. Production remains at 15f2eebc with all copier controls OFF and host admission OFF.
